title: PolicyAuditPage
description: GET /api/policy-audit (admin only): who changed which rule and who was refused, newest first. Stored payloads are whitelisted rule values and bookkeeping: no ERP id and no typed text; products appear by SKU.

action.description: For example policy.saved, budget_cap.saved, stocking.saved, censoring_rule.saved, parameter.saved, access.refused

entity_id.description: A SKU, a rule name or a policy scope key; never an ERP id

reason_code.description: Stable refusal code when the outcome is refused

unavailable.description: Sources that could not be read; the page is incomplete for them

truncated.description: Sources that returned their full row limit: older matching rows may exist, so the dates should be narrowed
